description: This is a PHP source file defining a controller class 'SaveCustomerController' within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. The class extends from an abstract Vue controller and manages setting up components for customer save or edit views based on request attributes.

classes.name: SaveCustomerController
classes.description: Controller responsible for rendering the customer save/edit component based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering. Chooses between 'customer-edit' and 'customer-save' components based on the presence of an 'id' attribute in the request.
